title.zh: Celsius sues BitMEX for $495 million just 11 days before exchange shutdown
title.en: Celsius sues BitMEX for $495 million just 11 days before exchange shutdown

current_state.zh: Celsius's bankruptcy estate sued BitMEX for $495 million over the alleged wrongful liquidation and seizure of 6,360 BTC during the March 2020 crash, filing just 11 days before the exchange's shutdown.
current_state.en: Celsius's bankruptcy estate sued BitMEX for $495 million over the alleged wrongful liquidation and seizure of 6,360 BTC during the March 2020 crash, filing just 11 days before the exchange's shutdown.
